postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= d_i <= 10^9 for d_i in d) for n, k, l, d in zip(n_list, k_list, l_list, d_list))
postconditions.description: All depths are within the range [0, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 3 * 10^5 for n in n_list)
postconditions.description: The number of meters of sea is at least 1 and at most 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10^9 for k in k_list)
postconditions.description: The tide intensity is at least 1 and at most 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 10^9 for l in l_list)
postconditions.description: The maximum depth Koa can swim without drowning is at least 1 and at most 10^9.

invariants.expression: all(len(d) == n for n, d in zip(n_list, d_list))
invariants.description: The number of depths equals the number of meters of sea.
